input.text: A serene, reverent cinematic shot of Lord Ganesha walking slowly and gracefully through fresh snow in a quiet Himalayan mountain landscape at golden hour. Lord Ganesha in his traditional form: elephant head with one broken tusk, gentle kind eyes, four arms holding a modak, a lotus and a small axe, wearing a rich saffron-and-gold silk dhoti, gold crown and ornaments, a soft divine golden glow around him. Each step leaves soft footprints; gentle snowflakes drifting in warm sunlight; snow-covered pines and distant peaks. Slow tracking camera alongside him, shallow depth of field, photoreal, majestic and peaceful, devotional mood. Soft wind and a faint temple bell in the distance. No text.
